data.label: include
data.reason_zh: 提出SO-RSI，以执行轨迹诊断驱动工作流改写，并用跨轮持续探究记忆保留证据，属方法类RSI。

scope_support.feedback_quote: SO-RSI passively monitors execution traces for three structural anomalies (recurrence, opposing edits, and expectation mismatch) to trigger targeted mechanism investigations.
scope_support.object_quote: SO-RSI, a framework that elevates workflow optimization to a second-order diagnostic inquiry, investigating why failures occur before committing to structural interventions.
scope_support.persistence_quote: maintaining persistent inquiry memory across RSI rounds, SO-RSI accumulates causal evidence to guide systematic workflow edits
